jobs.title: Healthcare Application Developer
jobs.description:
Job Title: Healthcare Application Developer

Type: Contract

Location: Onsite - NJ

Experience: 0–2 Years

Job Summary

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Entry-Level Healthcare Application Developer
to support the development, maintenance, and enhancement of software applications used in the healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and life sciences industries.
The candidate will assist in developing healthcare technology solutions, building user-friendly application interfaces, integrating databases and APIs, and supporting software testing and troubleshooting. The role involves collaborating with software developers, healthcare professionals, business analysts, and quality teams to develop reliable applications that support clinical operations, laboratory workflows, patient data management, and pharmaceutical business processes.
This opportunity is suitable for recent graduates or candidates with 0–2 years of experience and an academic background in Computer Science, Information Technology, Biomedical Engineering, Health Informatics, Bioinformatics, or related fields.
Key Responsibilities

Application Development:
Assist in designing, developing, and maintaining healthcare and life sciences software applications based on business and technical requirements.
Frontend Development:
Develop user-friendly application interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks such as React or Angular.
Backend Development:
Support backend development using programming languages such as Java, Python, C#, or JavaScript.
Database Management:
Work with SQL databases to store, retrieve, update, and manage healthcare and pharmaceutical application data.
API Integration:
Assist in developing and integrating REST APIs to connect healthcare applications with databases and external systems.
Healthcare Systems Support:
Support applications related to Electronic Health Records (EHR), Electronic Medical Records (EMR), Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), and Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS).
Application Testing:
Perform basic functional testing, identify software defects, troubleshoot issues, and support application quality improvements.
Data Security:
Follow established security practices to protect sensitive healthcare information and maintain data confidentiality.
Documentation:
Prepare and maintain technical documentation, application specifications, test cases, and development reports.
System Maintenance:
Assist in debugging, application updates, performance monitoring, and resolving technical issues.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Work with healthcare professionals, software engineers, QA teams, and business analysts to understand application requirements.
Regulatory Awareness:
Support application development activities in accordance with applicable healthcare data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.

Required Skills

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Health Informatics, Bioinformatics, or a related field.
Basic knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, C#, or JavaScript.
Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frontend development concepts.
Basic knowledge of React, Angular, or other frontend frameworks.
Familiarity with SQL databases and database management concepts.
Understanding of REST APIs and application integration.
Basic knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and software testing.
Familiarity with version control tools such as Git and GitHub.
Basic understanding of healthcare applications, clinical data, or pharmaceutical systems.
Awareness of healthcare data privacy and security concepts.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Good communication, teamwork, and documentation skills.

jobs.description:
Overview i3 is seeking Software Engineers to join tour team in Huntsville, Alabama. You will help design, develop, integrate, test, and sustain mission‑critical command and control (C2) software used by our warfighters and customers around the world. In this role, you will support Agile Software Teams, working closely with systems and test engineers to build robust, secure, and scalable software solutions that address complex logical and mathematical challenges in support of Global C2 missions. This position is ideal for engineers who enjoy hands‑on development, solving complex technical problems, and collaborating in a highly integrated, Agile environment. Responsibilities * Design, develop, document, test, and debug applications and software systems that implement logical and mathematical solutions that are aligned with program objectives. * Participate in Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Scrum teams to develop and maintain software products across multiple software baselines for the IBCS program. * Work in a fast-paced environment with high expectations, diverse assignments, and collaborative team settings across all levels of the organization. * Perform software development and upgrades in multiple programming languages/versions while minimizing changes to the operational behavior of tactical software. * Support documentation creation and updates using Markdown and other collaboration tools. * Support testing activities including unit and functional testing, code coverage analysis, and static code analysis; contribute to continuous improvement of test effectiveness and automation. * Other duties as assigned. Qualifications Education, Experience and Required skills: * This role can be filled at mulitple levels

Associate Software Engineer- Bachelor's degree in a STEM field and at least 1 year of relevant experience
Software Engineer- Bachelor's degree in a STEM field and at least 2 years of relevant experience, Master's degree in STEM field and 0 years of relevant experience
Strong object-oriented software development experience with Java and C++ * Proficiency in Linux-based development and runtime environments. * Experience with scripting languages and tools including Bash and Python. * Experience with modern configuration management and source control tools (Git / GitLab). * Experience with Agile SAFe and Atlassian Agile tools including Jira and Confluence. * Active Secret Clearance and the ability to maintain a clearance required. * Must be a U.S. Citizen. Preferred Qualifications: * Experience with Model‑Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), including Cameo or similar tools. * Experience with DevSecOps and CI/CD pipelines to build, integrate, test and deliver software. * Experience supporting real-time or distributed systems using RTI/DDS publish/subscribe middleware. * Engagement: Experience with US Army Systems including PATRIOT, LTAMDS, SENTINEL A3/A4, IFF devices, and M_SHORAD. * Experience with Engagement Planning and Execution, PAC2/PAC3, and AIM9x, and Indirect Fires. * Track Management: Experience with track management including sensors, composite track, IFF devices, and Combat Identification. * CompTIA Security+ Physical Demands: * The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms.
The employee is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must be able to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
Regular i3 hours are 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. Monday-Friday, however, additional hours may be required on occasion. Regular and punctual attendance is required. About i3 Founded in 2007, Integration Innovation, Inc. (i3) is headquartered in Huntsville, AL, with additional offices in Orlando, FL, and the National Capital Region. We are a 100% team member-owned mid-tier integrator with over 800 employee-owners, and our culture speaks for itself: we've earned ten Best Places to Work® awards, driven by strong employee engagement, transparent leadership, and a genuine commitment to communication. i3 team members operate at the leading edge of national defense across a broad range of technical disciplines, from systems and software engineering to modeling, simulation, and training solutions to cybersecurity, digital engineering, and enterprise IT. We also take products from prototype through production, bringing that same engineering rigor to manufacturing and delivering hardware at scale. For candidates, that means a rare opportunity: the innovation and mission focus of an engineering services company paired with the hands-on impact of building and delivering real solutions that benefit the Warfighter, all inside an employee-owned company where your contributions directly shape both the mission and your ownership stake in the business.

jobs.title: Junior Frontend Engineer & Technology Support | Dermstore
jobs.description:
About THG

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.  
Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.  
From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.   
With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?  
Life at THG Beauty 

We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.
By combining our portfolio of owned brands with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.
THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader. 

Why be a Junior Frontend Engineer & Technology Support at THG Beauty?

Dermstore is the premier destination for professional-grade skincare and clinical beauty, curated by experts and trusted by enthusiasts. Since its founding by a dermatologist, Dermstore has been a pioneer in the digital beauty space, offering a highly curated selection of the world’s most efficacious brands across skincare, hair care, and cosmetics. As a leader in prestige beauty e-commerce, we bridge the gap between clinical expertise and a premium shopping experience.
This is a unique hybrid opportunity for someone who is early in their front-end engineering career and has hands-on IT and desktop support experience. You’ll contribute to modern headless ecommerce applications using JavaScript and work closely with senior engineers while also providing onsite technology support to employees at our New York office.
This role offers the opportunity to grow your frontend engineering career while using your existing IT support experience to make an immediate impact.

As Junior Frontend Engineer & Technology Support , you’ll:   

Frontend Engineering

Build and maintain frontend applications using JavaScript/ES6+ and frameworks such as React, Vue, or similar.
Contribute to fast, scalable, secure, and accessible headless ecommerce experiences.
Work with senior engineers to understand system architecture, APIs, data structures, and how different systems communicate.
Contribute to frontend performance, accessibility, security, and observability.
Write clean, maintainable code and follow development standards and best practices.
Participate in code reviews and pair programming.
Work with UX, CRO, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver new features and improvements.
Develop your knowledge of headless ecommerce, SSG, APIs, and GraphQL.
Help create intuitive, inclusive user experiences.
Stay curious about new technologies, share ideas, and continue developing your technical skills.

Technology & IT Support

Provide hands-on onsite technology support to employees.
Troubleshoot laptops, desktops, applications, and operating systems.
Support Dell/Windows and macOS environments.
Support Microsoft 365, including Teams, Outlook, and SharePoint.
Assist with device enrollment, configuration, replacements, onboarding, and offboarding.
Provide support for Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and Okta
Troubleshoot authentication issues and escalate more complex issues
Provide basic Wi-Fi and network troubleshooting.
Support meeting rooms, AV, video conferencing, and workplace technology.
Assist employees with workplace technologies, including corporate printing.
Maintain technical documentation and asset records.
Provide excellent employee onboarding/offboarding support for tech
Work closely with global Technology teams, including colleagues in the UK.

What skills and experience do I need for this role?

3-4 years of experience in desktop support, end-user IT, service desk, or onsite technology support.
Strong hands-on troubleshooting experience across laptops, desktops, applications, and peripherals.
Experience supporting Dell/Windows and macOS.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365.
Experience or exposure to Entra ID and Intune.
Experience supporting Okta or a similar authentication platform.
Basic networking knowledge, including Wi-Fi and TCP/IP.
Experience with meeting rooms, AV, video conferencing, device management, and onboarding/offboarding.
Strong communication and customer service skills.

Frontend Experience

Some experience building frontend applications through professional experience, internships, university, bootcamp, personal projects, or open-source contributions.
Good working knowledge of JavaScript, including vanilla JavaScript and ES6+.
Experience with or exposure to React, Vue, or a similar frontend framework.
Understanding of HTML, CSS, APIs, and modern web development.
Understanding of core programming concepts, including events, error handling, inheritance, and asynchronous programming.
Awareness of web accessibility and WCAG principles.
Interest in headless ecommerce, SSG, GraphQL, frontend performance, and modern web technologies.

About You

You enjoy both building technology and helping people solve technology problems.
You’re comfortable working with senior engineers, asking questions, learning new technologies, and sharing ideas. You have strong attention to detail and enjoy working collaboratively with technical and non-technical teams.
You’re also comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change and you may need to move between frontend development and hands-on employee support.

What’s in it for me?

Salary: $90,000 to $100,000 based on experience
Hybrid Work Model - 3 days office/2 days home
Medical, Dental, Vision plans

401K matched up to 5%
Generous PTO (Paid Time Off)
Short and long-term disability
Exclusive employee discounts off THG Brands

THG is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.

jobs.title: Mid-Level Full-Stack AI Solutions Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About AlarisPro

AlarisPro is the aviation industry’s only aviation-minded, cloud-based UAS fleet management platform. It replaces spreadsheets and disconnected tools with one powerful system that unifies safety, compliance, and operational intelligence through centralized tracking of flights, maintenance, parts, and aircraft configuration.

Now we are building the future of Preventive Maintenance Artificial Intelligence. AlarisPro is evolving from a data provider into an AI solutions integrator—turning trusted operational data into intelligence, recommendations, and better decisions for UAS operators.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on, growing engineer who can strengthen the platform we operate today while helping build the intelligent products of tomorrow. This is not a narrow database, front-end, or AI role. Working with experienced technical and product leaders, you will contribute across the current Microsoft-based application stack, modern cloud services, APIs, user experiences, and emerging AI capabilities.

You will be successful if you enjoy modernizing real production systems, learn the aviation domain, use AI coding tools fluently, and work with product and design partners to move from raw information to trusted decisions.

This is a hybrid position based in Southern Maryland. Applicants must currently reside in the United States and be legally authorized to work in the U.S. Company-paid relocation assistance is available for qualified candidates. Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience, qualifications, and technical expertise.

What You Will Build?

·    Evolve the current platform.
Develop, optimize, secure, and maintain AlarisPro’s MSSQL, ASP.NET/.NET, IIS, API, and React capabilities.
·     Create the modern AI stack.
Contribute to cloud-native services, AI-enabled workflows, retrieval and reasoning capabilities, model integrations, evaluation approaches, and production-ready data pipelines.
·     Applications that turn information into decisions.
Build experiences that surface risks, identify patterns, recommend actions, and support preventive maintenance and operational decision-making.
·     Connect the ecosystem.
Design secure, documented REST APIs and integrations that allow internal services, customers, partners, and AI agents to work with AlarisPro data and capabilities.
·     Build usable front ends.
Create responsive, accessible interfaces that make complex safety, compliance, maintenance, and fleet intelligence understandable and actionable.
·     Use AI-assisted engineering responsibly.
Apply AI tools (e.g., Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) to accelerate discovery, prototyping, refactoring, testing, documentation, and delivery—with human review and production engineering discipline.

Core Responsibilities:

Production Platform & Data

·   
 Develop and optimize T-SQL stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, schemas, indexes, and execution plans.
·    Monitor reliability and performance; troubleshoot deadlocks, blocking, long-running queries, resource utilization, and application/database issues.
·    Maintain data integrity, security, availability, backup/recovery practices, and compliance controls.
·    Develop, debug, refactor, review, deploy, and support ASP.NET/.NET applications, React Native, and IIS-hosted services.
AI, Cloud & Integration

·    
Prototype and deploy AI capabilities that use AlarisPro’s trusted operational data to improve maintenance, safety, compliance, and fleet decisions.
·    Build and consume secure REST APIs using appropriate authentication patterns, including JWT, OAuth 2.0, API keys, and related controls.
·    Contribute to cloud architecture, deployment automation, observability, CI/CD, testing, and scalable service design, with an emphasis on AWS environments.
·    Help evaluate new models, frameworks, and coding agents; document findings, technical decisions, and measurable product outcomes.
Product, Design & Collaboration

·   
 Partner with customers and stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, risks, and decisions—not simply requested features.
·    Use Design Thinking and product management methods to frame problems, prototype quickly, test assumptions, prioritize value, and iterate from evidence.
·    Bridge aviation operational requirements, product objectives, user experience, and technical constraints to develop effective, practical software solutions.
·    Contribute to roadmaps, requirements, acceptance criteria, code reviews, technical documentation, testing, and release readiness.

What We Are Looking For:

Required Experience

·   
 Hands-on development with C# or VB.NET and ASP.NET Web Forms, MVC, .NET Core, or a comparable .NET application environment.
·    Experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with cloud-hosted applications, databases, or services.
·    Front-end development experience; HTML, JavaScript, CSS, React or comparable modern frameworks are strongly valued.
·    Practical experience using Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI coding tools.
·    Working knowledge of Git, testing, secure development, code review, deployment, and production troubleshooting.
·    Ability to contribute across the stack, communicate clearly, ask good questions, reliably estimate tasks assigned, document work, and deliver reliably and on time in a fast-moving environment.
Preferred Experience
·    3+ years of professional software or data-platform engineering experience, including meaningful hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL.
·    AWS architecture, application/API hosting, WebSocket’s, managed databases, and cloud observability.
·    SQL Agent automation, Microsoft SQL database administration, IIS configuration, high availability, and performance engineering.
·    Applied AI/ML, LLM integrations, retrieval-augmented generation, automated integration testing, model evaluation, or MLOps/LLMOps.
·    Product discovery, Design Thinking, user research, prototyping, backlog prioritization, or product management practices.
·    Experience in aviation, UAS/drone operations, fleet operations of any type, preventive maintenance, safety, regulatory compliance, or other high-reliability domains are a plus.

Our Approach to AI-Assisted Development

We value speed, curiosity, and strong tool fluency. We also expect engineering judgment. AI-generated code must be understood, reviewed, tested, secured, documented, and operated like any other production code. The goal is not to generate more code; it is to deliver better outcomes faster.

Success in This Role

Success in this role means consistently delivering high-quality software solutions that improve the AlarisPro platform and provide meaningful value to our customers. The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
·       Ownership and Accountability:
Take responsibility for assigned projects and deliver reliable, well-tested solutions on schedule with minimal oversight.
·        Productivity and Execution:
Consistently make measurable progress, manage priorities effectively, and deliver results in a fast-paced development environment.
·        Problem-Solving:
Independently analyze complex challenges, identify practical solutions, and exercise sound technical judgment.
·        User-Centered Design:
Apply Design Thinking principles to translate aviation operational requirements and customer needs into intuitive, efficient software solutions.
·        Software Quality:
Develop maintainable, scalable, and secure code while minimizing defects, technical debt, and unnecessary complexity.
·        Collaboration and Communication:
Work effectively with leadership, product stakeholders, and fellow engineers while proactively communicating progress, challenges, and solutions.
·        Continuous Improvement:
Demonstrate initiative in improving existing functionality, development processes, and overall user experience.
·        Business and Mission Awareness:
Understand how software development decisions affect customer operations, aviation safety, regulatory compliance, and AlarisPro's business objectives.

Why Join AlarisPro?

Join AlarisPro at an exciting stage of growth and innovation, where you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the future of unmanned systems. You'll help shape the continued evolution of a proven, industry-leading platform at the intersection of aviation safety, cloud technology, and applied AI. Leveraging extensive real-world operational data, you'll contribute to the development of next-generation capabilities in predictive maintenance, reliability analytics, and intelligent decision support that improve aviation safety and operational efficiency.

The Developer analyzes and changes information systems to meet customer and business needs. This is a fully remote role with a U.S.-based professional services firm. Their technology, AI and data teams are expanding fast, and you’d be joining at exactly the right moment.

Machine Learning Engineer | AI Security & Fraud Detection

Location:
San Francisco, CA - Onsite
Compensation:
$180,000–$260,000 Base + Equity (Flexible up to $300,000 for Exceptional Candidates)
Experience:
3+ Years, Ideally 5+ Years
Industry:
AI Infrastructure, Agentic AI, Cybersecurity, Fraud Prevention

About the Opportunity

Shields Group Search is partnering with a well-funded, early-stage AI infrastructure startup building the trust and security layer for the rapidly emerging AI agent economy.
As AI agents increasingly act autonomously on behalf of individuals and businesses, from booking services and accessing APIs to executing financial transactions, companies need infrastructure that can determine which agents are legitimate, who they represent, what actions they're authorized to perform, and whether their behavior presents a security or fraud risk.
Our client is building real-time verification and decisioning infrastructure that enables businesses to safely interact with AI agents at scale.
The platform combines agent identity verification, behavioral intelligence, risk assessment, and security controls to distinguish legitimate automated activity from suspicious or malicious behavior.

We're looking for an exceptional Machine Learning Engineer to build the models that distinguish a trusted AI agent from an attack, in real time and under load.

This is an opportunity to join a small, highly technical founding-stage engineering team and take meaningful ownership of mission-critical ML infrastructure.
What You'll Be Working On
The models behind this platform operate directly on the production request path. They must evaluate activity and support trust decisions in real time, under the same strict latency constraints as the rest of the infrastructure.
There is no offline batch job to hide behind and no second chance if a prediction is too slow or incorrect.

You'll work on problems involving:

Real-Time Fraud & Threat Detection:
Develop ML models that identify potentially fraudulent, malicious, or unauthorized agent activity while minimizing false positives.
Behavioral & Anomaly Detection:
Identify suspicious patterns, anomalous agent interactions, and emerging risks across automated transactions and API activity.
Low-Latency ML Inference:
Build and optimize production model-serving systems capable of making accurate decisions under demanding latency and throughput requirements.
Cold-Start & Low-Label Learning:
Develop effective detection approaches when labeled examples are scarce, including unsupervised learning, weak supervision, and custom evaluation datasets.
End-to-End ML Ownership:
Build, evaluate, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve production ML systems, from data and feature pipelines through real-time serving.
Adversarial ML:
Help build systems that remain effective as malicious actors adapt their behavior to evade detection.
Agentic AI Infrastructure:
Work at the intersection of modern ML, AI agents, tool calling, identity verification, and security.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

3+ years of professional ML experience
, ideally 5+ years, building, evaluating, and deploying production models, not just research or notebooks.
Strong Python and a modern ML framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow); solid SQL.
Production ML systems end to end: feature pipelines, training, evaluation, and low-latency, real-time serving.
Comfort with low-label and cold-start problems, including anomaly detection, unsupervised methods, weak supervision, and building evaluation sets and labels from scratch.
Data analysis, statistics, and experiment design.
Strong software engineering. You ship versioned, testable, reproducible code, not throwaway models.
Experience working in highly technical engineering environments with strong software engineering standards.
Ability to take ownership, solve ambiguous problems, and ship production-grade solutions in a fast-moving startup environment.

Strongly Preferred

Applied ML in fraud, risk, abuse, account integrity, or security.
Experience building ML models for fraud prevention, threat detection, trust and safety, or other systems designed to prevent malicious activity.
Graph ML / GNNs, sequence or behavioral modeling, or anomaly detection.
LLM / NLP work, and familiarity with AI agents, including tool use, function calling, and MCP.
Experience in adversarial settings, where the threat evolves against the model.
Explainable, auditable, reproducible ML, with real model versioning.
Experience developing ML systems at highly technical, engineering-driven companies, particularly those working on large-scale infrastructure, payments, fraud prevention, cybersecurity, or AI platforms.

Bonus Qualifications

Payment protocols (x402), agent identity (DID / VC), or crypto commitments (Merkle anchoring).
Experience at an early-stage startup or building ML infrastructure from the ground up.
Familiarity with real-time transaction monitoring, behavioral risk scoring, or identity verification systems.

Compensation & Work Arrangement

Base Salary:
$180,000–$260,000, with flexibility up to approximately $300,000 for exceptional candidates.
Equity:
Competitive equity participation in an early-stage, venture-backed company.
Location:
San Francisco, CA.

The team strongly prefers engineers working onsite five days per week. Hybrid flexibility may be considered for exceptional candidates who can regularly collaborate in person.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer (MLOps & Data)
jobs.description:
About Surgeon Decision Intelligence (SDI)

SDI is a healthcare AI startup building surgical decision-support tools for spine surgery. Founded by
practicing spine surgeons and academic faculty, we combine deep clinical expertise with modern
machine learning to improve surgical planning and patient outcomes. Our platform spans medical
imaging pipelines, clinical outcomes data, and ML models that operate on both.

The role

We have working models: code that takes in an MRI series and produces measurements surgeons care
about. We need an engineer to turn them into production systems that are tested, versioned, deployed
and monitored, with every output traceable to the model, code and data that produced it. This is an
MLOps-focused role: reproducibility, versioning, deployment and monitoring of our models are the core
of the job.

An implementation partner is currently standing up our core platform: Databricks, MLflow, our
databases and model serving. You'll work alongside them during the build, take ownership when they
hand it over, and be the person who gets our models onto it and keeps them running. You'll also help
grow and connect the data our research depends on.

This is a hands-on engineering role on a small team. You'll work closely with our Principal AI/ML Engineer
on how models are built, tracked, released and served.

What you'll work on in your first year

Take our models from prototype to production.
Refactor MVP model code, starting with our MRI

imaging pipeline, into tested, typed, reproducible Python packages. Find out what's slow and make it
fast.
Make every result reproducible and traceable.
Register models in MLflow with pinned code,

environment and data versions. Build batch and online inference on Databricks so that every stored
output records the model that produced it. Define how a new model is validated, promoted and
rolled back, and write those procedures down.
Build the path from research code to production.
Set up project templates, CI, code review

and a clear path from "my model works" to "my model is registered and deployable" for everyone on
the team who writes model code.
Grow and connect our research data.
Our core research datasets already exist. You'll help shape

how they need to grow and change as we do, and connect our data sources (imaging, annotations,
scanner and protocol metadata, clinical outcomes) so researchers can find, query and use them.
That includes designing schemas, versioning the datasets our models are trained and evaluated on,
and writing loaders that handle the edge cases real-world data throws at you.
Own the platform.
Once our partner hands it over, you'll run it day to day: CI/CD, access, cost and

upgrades. You'll also set up monitoring for the services and for data and model drift, so we find out
about problems before our users do.

What we're looking for

2+ years of professional software engineering, mostly in Python, writing tested code that runs in

production.
You've taken at least one ML system from prototype to production yourself and kept it running

afterward, so you know what breaks.
A working understanding of how models are trained and evaluated, enough to reproduce a training

run: seeds, nondeterministic GPU operations, data splits, preprocessing versions. Experience with
PyTorch.
Hands-on MLOps: experiment tracking or a model registry (MLflow or similar), deploying model

inference, and CI/CD.
Data engineering: you've built pipelines that produce datasets other people train on. Relational

database design in PostgreSQL or similar: schemas, migrations, constraints, and knowing when not
to normalize.
You've reviewed other people's code and helped less experienced developers write better software

without slowing them down.
You've worked at a startup or on a small team where you owned work end to end.
You can take a loosely defined problem, ask the right questions, and come back with a working

solution without needing step-by-step direction.

Nice to have

Databricks (strongly preferred): Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Spark, Model Serving, Workflows.
Medical imaging experience: DICOM, MRI or CT pipelines, de-identification.
Longitudinal clinical or outcomes data, including follow-up and censored time-to-event data.
Regulated healthcare software: HIPAA and handling patient data, FDA software as a medical device,

design controls.
Azure (blob storage, Entra ID) or another major cloud.
Building and deploying APIs (FastAPI or similar).
Storing and compressing vectors: pgvector, quantization, dimensionality reduction.
Speeding up numerical Python code (NumPy, PyTorch, GPUs).
Side projects you've built and shipped on your own.

What this role is not

Not primarily a research or modeling role.
Your main job is making our models reproducible and

reliable in production, and building the data they're trained on. You'll need to understand our
models, and because we're a small team you may contribute to research from time to time, but it
won't be the core of the role.
Not building a platform from scratch, or tuning one component of a large system.
Our core

infrastructure is being stood up now. Your job is to own it and put our work on it, across the stack.

Location: Remote to start, transitioning to in person in New York City
Employment type: Full-time
Compensation: $140,000–$175,000 base salary + equity + benefits

WHAT IS BOX?

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

Box’s Edge team powers the connectivity behind our products, including Box Zones and applications hosted across our environment. We’re looking for a Software Engineer III to design and build backend services and automation that turn complex network functionality into simple, safe, and repeatable workflows. jobs.description:
Platform Engineer

Role Purpose

Lead the design, build, and operation of a secure, scalable migration platform to move object data from OBSv2 to AWS S3.
The role focuses on reliable execution, automation, governance, monitoring, and production support for large-scale enterprise data migration.

Key Responsibilities
Own the end-to-end migration workflow from OBSv2 source buckets to AWS S3 destination buckets.
Build and operate AWS-based orchestration using Step Functions, Lambda, Fargate, AWS Batch, DynamoDB, SQS, and rclone.
Support both manifest-based and dynamic migration approaches, including batching, sharding, task sizing, and retry handling.
Implement governance for bandwidth allocation, queue management, prioritisation, throttling, and job tracking.
Build observability through CloudWatch dashboards, logs, metrics, alerts, health checks, and progress reporting.
Support secure multi-account deployment, IAM controls, privacy safeguards, testing, performance tuning, and production cutover.

Expected Deliverables
Production-ready migration orchestration platform supporting both manifest and no-manifest paths.
Hub-side governance for bandwidth control, queue processing, throttling, and completion reporting.
Reusable rclone-based migration runtime with progress reporting and dynamic throttle support.
DynamoDB-backed job, task, queue, bandwidth, and summary state management.
CloudWatch dashboards, alarms, logs, runbooks, deployment automation, and operational documentation.

Preferred Experience
Experience with Dell ECS, OBSv2, or other S3-compatible enterprise object storage platforms.
Experience delivering enterprise-scale migrations in regulated, production environments.
Experience with hub-and-spoke operating models across multiple AWS accounts.
Ability to produce clear technical documentation and leadership-ready reporting.

Mandatory Technical Skills
1. AWS Serverless

Hands-on experience with AWS Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, API Gateway, SSM Parameter Store, and Secrets Manager.

2. AWS Compute and Containers

Strong working knowledge of ECS Fargate, AWS Batch, container task definitions, sidecar patterns, resource sizing, and runtime environment configuration.

3. AWS Storage

Deep understanding of Amazon S3, S3 Intelligent-Tiering, S3-compatible APIs, object metadata, prefix structures, large object transfers, and lifecycle considerations.

4. Object Storage Migration

Experience migrating large object datasets from on-premises or S3-compatible platforms such as Dell ECS/OBSv2 to AWS S3.

5. rclone

Hands-on experience configuring and operating rclone for high-volume transfers, including transfers, checkers, retries, checksum validation, no-traverse behaviour, stats, logs, and bandwidth limiting.

6. Python Development

Strong Python skills for Lambda and Fargate services, including boto3, JSON processing, exception handling, logging, dataclasses, streaming files, and API integration.

7. DynamoDB

Ability to design and operate DynamoDB tables, keys, indexes, scans, updates, batch writes, Decimal handling, and state-management patterns.

8. Networking

Understanding of AWS Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPCs, private subnets, routing, S3 Gateway Endpoints, NAT Gateway scoping, and high-throughput network design.

9. IAM and Security

Strong knowledge of IAM roles, cross-account access, STS assume-role, API keys, Secrets Manager, least-privilege design, and secure operational access.

10. Observability

Experience with CloudWatch metrics, logs, alarms, dashboards, structured logging, operational telemetry, and migration progress reporting.

11. CI/CD and Deployment

Experience with GitLab repositories, CI/CD pipelines, environment-specific configuration, infrastructure deployment, and safe teardown procedures.

Know-How Skills and Domain Understanding
Understand large-scale object storage migration patterns, including manifests, prefix-based partitioning, batching, and validation.
Balance migration performance across data volume, object count, compute resources, network capacity, and rclone concurrency.
Design fair bandwidth allocation, throttling, queue handling, retry, and escalation models for production migrations.
Apply strong operational discipline across monitoring, runbooks, restart procedures, completion checks, and stakeholder reporting.
Maintain clear technical documentation, architecture notes, input contracts, implementation details, and support procedures.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Company

We engineer connectivity and embedded compute solutions that power connected devices worldwide. With decades of experience, our solutions are secure by design, globally compliant and supported over long lifecycles.

About the Role

The Embedded Software Engineer designs, develops, and supports Wi-Fi radio firmware and driver software for Ezurio's wireless connectivity products, working closely with the RF hardware development team in the USA and Taiwan, program management, and customers to deliver reliable, innovative, and resilient embedded software. The ideal candidate is comfortable working close to the metal - register-level access, bootloaders, and drivers in a resource-constrained environment - as well as building the connectivity stacks that sit above them, and brings strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills to complex hardware/software and RF interaction issues. Deep 802.11 protocol expertise is not required; we are willing to train a strong embedded/RTOS candidate on the Wi-Fi-specific pieces. Experience developing software for network protocols (Wi-Fi, TCP/IP, or similar) is a useful plus. This role is preferably based in hybrid work arrangement in Akron, Ohio. Remote candidates will also be considered. Legal authorization to work in the US is required.

Responsibilities

Wi-Fi Radio Firmware Development

Design, develop, and maintain firmware for Wi-Fi radio subsystems, including MAC/PHY interfacing, calibration routines, and channel/RF management.
Bring up Wi-Fi silicon on new hardware platforms: port and validate vendor SDKs, drivers, and radio calibration data for new designs.
Develop and maintain radio firmware within an RTOS environment (e.g., ThreadX or similar) and host-side Wi-Fi drivers under Linux, with real-time scheduling, interrupt handling, and register-level access to radio and host interfaces (SDIO, PCIe, USB, DMA).
Write clean, well-documented, testable code following Ezurio coding standards and secure development practices.
Support 802.11 protocol-layer behavior (association, authentication, power-save, rate adaptation) and power management/wake-on-wireless design in coordination with vendor stacks.

Debug, Test & Quality

Debug complex RF firmware issues using tools such on hardware where on-device debug access (e.g., JTAG/debug ports) is limited, using debug output, code analysis, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and Wi-Fi packet capture tools (e.g., Wireshark) and JTAG/SWD
Develop and execute unit, functional, integration, and system-level tests; work with SWQA teams to contribute to test infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines.
Reproduce, isolate, and resolve field and customer-reported Wi-Fi issues (throughput, roaming, association drops, coexistence) and drive issues to root cause and closure.
Participate in code reviews and enforce quality gates across the software development lifecycle.

Cross-Functional & Customer Collaboration

Partner with the RF hardware team (USA and Taiwan) during schematic review, antenna design, and prototype bring-up to flag firmware-relevant design considerations early.
Work directly with customers and program managers to clarify Wi-Fi firmware requirements, scope, and acceptance criteria for co-development programs.
Support manufacturing, NPI, and DVT/PVT activities with RF test tools, calibration procedures, and production-line firmware as needed.
Provide clear technical status updates to program managers and contribute to schedule and risk discussions.

Documentation & Process

Produce and maintain technical documentation: design specifications, API references, porting guides, and release notes.
Maintain source control hygiene, branching strategy, and release/versioning discipline across active programs.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of embedded software development practices within the Custom SOM & SBC group.

Qualifications

Strong proficiency in C working in embedded, memory-constrained, real-time systems.
Solid understanding of processor architecture, memory management, and real-time constraints in embedded systems and working with register access.
Proven debugging skills across the hardware/software boundary, using debug output, JTAG/SWD, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and ideally Wi-Fi packet capture tools.
Demonstrated persistence and rigor in debugging and driving issues to true root cause rather than applying surface-level fixes.
Ability to read schematics and datasheets, and to communicate effectively with RF hardware engineers on radio and interface details.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting technical status to customers and internal stakeholders.
Effective collaborator in a fast-paced, globally distributed team environment (coordinating with the RF hardware team in the USA and Taiwan), able to manage multiple concurrent programs.
Ideally hand-on RTOS experience: task scheduling, interrupt handling, and priority management in a resource-constrained system. Note that specific RTOS experience e.g. ThreadX, Zephyr, or similar matters less than a working understanding of RTOS concepts and real hands-on time in one.
Working knowledge of Linux (kernel modules, device drivers, kernel/user-space interfaces) is a plus, since our Wi-Fi drivers run under Linux.
Experience with host interfaces such as SDIO, PCIe, or USB is most relevant; familiarity with SPI, I2C, and UART is also useful.
Exposure to 802.11 MAC-layer concepts (association, authentication, power-save, rate adaptation) is a plus; we will train a strong embedded/RTOS candidate who doesn't yet have this.
Working knowledge of version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and issue tracking tools such as Jira.
Chipset vendor SDK exposure is a plus: Cypress/Infineon, NXP, Qualcomm/Atheros (QCA) or similar Wi-Fi silicon vendors.
Familiarity with RF/PHY concepts (calibration, gain control, channel switching) is a plus.
Prior experience with another wireless or networking protocol stacks e.g. Bluetooth, Zigbee, Thread, Cellular is valuable even without direct Wi-Fi background.
Power management firmware experience (sleep states, wake-on-wireless) is a plus, especially for battery-powered or IoT platforms.

Education/Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. Equivalent professional experience considered in lieu of degree.
5+ years of embedded software or firmware development experience in an electronics design and manufacturing environment.
Direct experience with Wi-Fi or other wireless radio firmware/driver bring-up is strongly preferred; we will train a strong embedded/RTOS candidate without direct Wi-Fi background.
Experience supporting customer co-development programs (NRE-based or joint development agreements) is a plus.
Experience with wireless certification, RF coexistence, or low-power design considerations is a plus.
This role is based in Akron, OH on a hybrid schedule with at least weekly in-office presence, to support close collaboration with the RF hardware and QA teams. Fully remote work will be considered on a case-by-case basis for exceptional candidates with deep Wi-Fi radio chip experience (e.g., QCA, Infineon, NXP).

We're an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Advanced ATE Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

As an Advanced Test Engineer here at Honeywell Aerospace, you will play a pivotal role in advancing the quality and reliability of aerospace products through innovative test engineering practices. You will lead the development and execution of sophisticated test plans and procedures, leveraging cutting-edge methodologies to ensure our aerospace solutions meet the highest standards of performance and safety.

You will report directly to our Engineering Manager, and you’ll work out of our Richardson, TX location on a 9/80 work schedule.

In this role, you will impact the aerospace industry by ensuring that Honeywell’s aerospace products are rigorously tested and validated, contributing to safer and more efficient air travel worldwide. Delivering mission-critical, electronic solutions that protect lives. Use your creativity and critical thinking to take our products from concept to customer. You will lead the development and execution of sophisticated test solutions for Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuits (MMICs). This role involves analyzing detailed test requirements and designing advanced Automated Test Equipment (ATE) systems tailored to customer specifications. The engineer will create and implement comprehensive test strategies, including test plans, acceptance procedures, and rigorous design verification processes.

The position requires leadership in enhancing team test capabilities through planning, coordination, and development of custom test equipment, including fixture design and fabrication. Responsibilities include performing RF test setup, calibration, validation, and troubleshooting of complex assemblies to ensure accurate, repeatable measurements.

The engineer will develop and maintain automated test software using National Instruments LabVIEW, integrating instrumentation and databases to enable scalable, efficient, and high-throughput testing environments. Additional duties include conducting advanced troubleshooting, failure analysis, and root cause investigations for MMIC devices and RF assemblies, as well as executing product qualification and environmental stress testing to meet industry standards.

This role also involves generating detailed technical reports, managing test data systems, and supporting laboratory operations such as asset tracking and equipment maintenance. Precision work under microscopes for inspection, assembly support, and failure analysis are also required. The ideal candidate is highly technical, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently in a fast-paced engineering environment.

Responsibilities

Design and maintain automated test software for ATE systems using LabVIEW, Python, C, C++, Visual Basic and other industry-standard test development tools to improve efficiency and data integrity
Analyze customer specifications to define test requirements, configurations, and acceptance criteria for MMIC testing
Develop and implement comprehensive test plans, including ATE configurations, fixtures, and software/hardware interfaces
Perform RF characterization of MMIC/semiconductor testing devices, including S-parameters, output power, noise figure, and two-tone measurements
Set up, calibrate, and execute RF test systems and on-wafer probe testing using appropriate standards
Troubleshoot and diagnose complex RF circuits independently using strong microwave theory knowledge
Conduct statistical analysis and generate detailed technical reports on test results and performance
Manage laboratory operations, including test databases, equipment calibration, asset tracking, and vendor procurement support

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as science, technology, engineering, mathematics
Minimum of 5 years of RF experience specific with ATE for RF/Microwave and components including the development and testing of components, experience in building rack & stack test equipment.
Minimum of 3years of test software development including LabVIEW, Python, MSQL, C, C++
Minimum of 2 years of experience in manufacturing or in a high-tech electronics industry.
Minimum of 2 years of using Microsoft Office Suite including SharePoint and Excel.

WE VALUE

Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field or equivalent education and experience.
Experience developing ATE software and operating RF test equipment, including wafer probe stations, VNAs, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, power supplies, and RF calibration standards
Strong RF characterization expertise for GaN/GaAs MMICs, including S-parameters, large-signal, two-tone, and stability testing through Ka-band
Proficiency interpreting schematics, technical drawings, and applying core electronics and microwave theory fundamentals
Hands-on experience with RF test fixtures, PCB design, and assembly, including wire bonding of MMIC devices for test readiness
Ability to perform precision work under a microscope with sub-micron geometries
Familiarity with DoD/military qualification and testing standards
Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work cross-functionally while also operating independently with accountability and initiative
Demonstrated adaptability, problem-solving, and continuous improvement mindset, with strong organizational and time management skills in dynamic environments

Us Person Requirements

Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status.

Benefits

Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
Short-term and long-term disability coverage
401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
Employee assistance program and educational assistance
Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. new_jobs.description:
About THG

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.  
Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.  
From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.   
With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?  
Life at THG Beauty 

We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.
By combining our portfolio of owned brands with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.
THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader. 

Why be a Junior Frontend Engineer & Technology Support at THG Beauty?

Dermstore is the premier destination for professional-grade skincare and clinical beauty, curated by experts and trusted by enthusiasts. Since its founding by a dermatologist, Dermstore has been a pioneer in the digital beauty space, offering a highly curated selection of the world’s most efficacious brands across skincare, hair care, and cosmetics. As a leader in prestige beauty e-commerce, we bridge the gap between clinical expertise and a premium shopping experience.
This is a unique hybrid opportunity for someone who is early in their front-end engineering career and has hands-on IT and desktop support experience. You’ll contribute to modern headless ecommerce applications using JavaScript and work closely with senior engineers while also providing onsite technology support to employees at our New York office.
This role offers the opportunity to grow your frontend engineering career while using your existing IT support experience to make an immediate impact.

As Junior Frontend Engineer & Technology Support , you’ll:   

Frontend Engineering

Build and maintain frontend applications using JavaScript/ES6+ and frameworks such as React, Vue, or similar.
Contribute to fast, scalable, secure, and accessible headless ecommerce experiences.
Work with senior engineers to understand system architecture, APIs, data structures, and how different systems communicate.
Contribute to frontend performance, accessibility, security, and observability.
Write clean, maintainable code and follow development standards and best practices.
Participate in code reviews and pair programming.
Work with UX, CRO, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver new features and improvements.
Develop your knowledge of headless ecommerce, SSG, APIs, and GraphQL.
Help create intuitive, inclusive user experiences.
Stay curious about new technologies, share ideas, and continue developing your technical skills.

Technology & IT Support

Provide hands-on onsite technology support to employees.
Troubleshoot laptops, desktops, applications, and operating systems.
Support Dell/Windows and macOS environments.
Support Microsoft 365, including Teams, Outlook, and SharePoint.
Assist with device enrollment, configuration, replacements, onboarding, and offboarding.
Provide support for Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and Okta
Troubleshoot authentication issues and escalate more complex issues
Provide basic Wi-Fi and network troubleshooting.
Support meeting rooms, AV, video conferencing, and workplace technology.
Assist employees with workplace technologies, including corporate printing.
Maintain technical documentation and asset records.
Provide excellent employee onboarding/offboarding support for tech
Work closely with global Technology teams, including colleagues in the UK.

What skills and experience do I need for this role?

3-4 years of experience in desktop support, end-user IT, service desk, or onsite technology support.
Strong hands-on troubleshooting experience across laptops, desktops, applications, and peripherals.
Experience supporting Dell/Windows and macOS.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365.
Experience or exposure to Entra ID and Intune.
Experience supporting Okta or a similar authentication platform.
Basic networking knowledge, including Wi-Fi and TCP/IP.
Experience with meeting rooms, AV, video conferencing, device management, and onboarding/offboarding.
Strong communication and customer service skills.

Frontend Experience

Some experience building frontend applications through professional experience, internships, university, bootcamp, personal projects, or open-source contributions.
Good working knowledge of JavaScript, including vanilla JavaScript and ES6+.
Experience with or exposure to React, Vue, or a similar frontend framework.
Understanding of HTML, CSS, APIs, and modern web development.
Understanding of core programming concepts, including events, error handling, inheritance, and asynchronous programming.
Awareness of web accessibility and WCAG principles.
Interest in headless ecommerce, SSG, GraphQL, frontend performance, and modern web technologies.

About You

You enjoy both building technology and helping people solve technology problems.
You’re comfortable working with senior engineers, asking questions, learning new technologies, and sharing ideas. You have strong attention to detail and enjoy working collaboratively with technical and non-technical teams.
You’re also comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change and you may need to move between frontend development and hands-on employee support.

What’s in it for me?

Salary: $90,000 to $100,000 based on experience
Hybrid Work Model - 3 days office/2 days home
Medical, Dental, Vision plans

401K matched up to 5%
Generous PTO (Paid Time Off)
Short and long-term disability
Exclusive employee discounts off THG Brands

THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.

THG is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.

Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG please contact one of our Talent team to discuss further.

Job description:

AgCountry Farm Credit Services (AgCountry), Farm Credit Services of America (FCSAmerica) and Frontier Farm Credit are financial cooperatives that operate under shared management across eight states. While each association is owned by its local farmers and ranchers, they collaborate by pooling resources, expertise, and talent to provide affordable credit, crop insurance, and financial services.

Our associations are united by a common mission and commitment to serving rural America and supporting each other, which drives the success of the farmers, ranchers, and agribusiness we serve. We take pride in being a great place to work, and this enthusiasm is reflected in the relationships our team members foster with one another and with our customers.

Job Summary *Hybrid-Incumbent must work three days per week in the Omaha, Ne office. 

We are looking for an Application Developer to join our Retail Lending developer team. In this role, you will be part of a full-stack, custom development team in a fast-paced, agile environment where agile development is embraced, and innovation is encouraged. You will participate in ideation and brainstorming sessions to devise creative and disruptive solutions, applications, APIs and data solutions to drive toward implementation of those solutions. You will be building solutions that support our customers and our teammates who serve them. Ultimately, your work will impact our mission to become Agriculture’s most valued financial partner.  
Essential Duties & Responsibilities Application Development Analysis: Analyze existing code bases, software systems, and integrated processes to identify areas for improvement. Collaborate with others to address customer and business problems by reviewing objectives, gathering facts, analyzing data, and proposing alternative solutions.
Stories / Requirements: Collaborate with product teammates to analyze and comprehend the intended purpose and functionality of the system. Examine existing stories and utilize them as a foundation for discussions. Additionally, consider expanding upon or proposing new narratives based on the insights gained during this process.
Development / Configuration: Develop and/or configure software to meet customer and business needs and adhere to technical and architectural standards or guidance.
Application Architecture: Implement and extend established application architecture and design patterns to maximize business alignment, quality, scalability, security, and performance.
CI/CD (Continuous Integration and Deployment): Refine and craft code to facilitate successful submission of development units to a source code repository, thereby enabling automated builds, deployment, and testing. Skillfully utilize tools and industry best practices to establish a foundation for continuous integration and ensure reliable, frequent releases.
Application Security: Adopt secure coding practices to develop robust and secure applications that defend against unauthorized access, data breaches, and code exploits. Collaborate with the App Sec team to execute a Red and Blue team PEN testing strategy for supported applications. Configure, execute, and oversee static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and container scans for supported systems. Address security vulnerabilities following Application Security guidelines to minimize security risk and exposure.
User Experience: Apply user experience design principles and established guidelines to develop and deploy user-centered solutions, effectively addressing customer problems and delivering delightful experiences.

Quality and Reliability Produce software solutions that inherently support testing at multiple levels prior to delivery. This includes decomposition of functions, interface-based design, dependency injection, unit testing, test-driven design, service-level testing, and ensuring support for user interface automation testing.
Monitor system performance to ensure that efficient operations and results are achieved. Provide on-going production support as needed.
Enhance and optimize systems to prevent user errors from causing system failures and ensure that operator errors are promptly detected. Follow and contribute to established practices such as maintaining version control, implementing build automation, conducting code analysis, and adhering to other quality guidelines and procedures.
Demonstrate understanding of nonfunctional requirements to ensure organizational service level agreement (SLA) and service level objective (SLO) metrics are met through the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and delivery pipeline.

Education Requirements Bachelors degree in Computer Science, MIS, Electrical Engineering or another relevant field preferred. 

Years of Experience 2+ years experience in software development. Demonstrated aptitude for technical problem solving, abstract thinking, and logic associated with software development.
Demonstrate technical capabilities through experience on assigned projects, utilizing technologies like Azure, .NET, Salesforce, or similar platforms.
For mobile development roles, expertise in native iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin), and/or Flutter development, or similar mobile technologies.
Experience in creating multi-tier and web-based applications utilizing Visual Studio and related Microsoft .NET or similar technologies (e.g., C#, Web API, Entity Framework, .NET Core).
Working knowledge of web scripting and responsive design patterns.
Familiarity with REST API, Angular, JavaScript, Typescript, HTML5, CSS, or similar web technologies and frameworks.
Experience with SQL Server or a similar relational database management system.

For qualifying positions, we provide a competitive benefits package designed to support health and well-being, financial security, and work-life balance:
Health Benefits

Retirement Plans
: 401(k) 
Paid Time Off
: Vacation, sick leave, paid holidays, and parental leave

: Life and disability insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), wellness programs, tuition assistance, and short-term incentive pay

For a comprehensive overview of our total reward offerings, click here.

AgCountry has 43 offices, is based in Fargo, North Dakota and serves portions of North Dakota, Minnesota, and Wisconsin. new_jobs.title: Mid-Level Full-Stack AI Solutions Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About AlarisPro

AlarisPro is the aviation industry’s only aviation-minded, cloud-based UAS fleet management platform. It replaces spreadsheets and disconnected tools with one powerful system that unifies safety, compliance, and operational intelligence through centralized tracking of flights, maintenance, parts, and aircraft configuration.

Now we are building the future of Preventive Maintenance Artificial Intelligence. AlarisPro is evolving from a data provider into an AI solutions integrator—turning trusted operational data into intelligence, recommendations, and better decisions for UAS operators.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on, growing engineer who can strengthen the platform we operate today while helping build the intelligent products of tomorrow. This is not a narrow database, front-end, or AI role. Working with experienced technical and product leaders, you will contribute across the current Microsoft-based application stack, modern cloud services, APIs, user experiences, and emerging AI capabilities.

You will be successful if you enjoy modernizing real production systems, learn the aviation domain, use AI coding tools fluently, and work with product and design partners to move from raw information to trusted decisions.

This is a hybrid position based in Southern Maryland. Applicants must currently reside in the United States and be legally authorized to work in the U.S. Company-paid relocation assistance is available for qualified candidates. Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience, qualifications, and technical expertise.

What You Will Build?

·    Evolve the current platform.
Develop, optimize, secure, and maintain AlarisPro’s MSSQL, ASP.NET/.NET, IIS, API, and React capabilities.
·     Create the modern AI stack.
Contribute to cloud-native services, AI-enabled workflows, retrieval and reasoning capabilities, model integrations, evaluation approaches, and production-ready data pipelines.
·     Applications that turn information into decisions.
Build experiences that surface risks, identify patterns, recommend actions, and support preventive maintenance and operational decision-making.
·     Connect the ecosystem.
Design secure, documented REST APIs and integrations that allow internal services, customers, partners, and AI agents to work with AlarisPro data and capabilities.
·     Build usable front ends.
Create responsive, accessible interfaces that make complex safety, compliance, maintenance, and fleet intelligence understandable and actionable.
·     Use AI-assisted engineering responsibly.
Apply AI tools (e.g., Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) to accelerate discovery, prototyping, refactoring, testing, documentation, and delivery—with human review and production engineering discipline.

Core Responsibilities:

Production Platform & Data

·   
 Develop and optimize T-SQL stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, schemas, indexes, and execution plans.
·    Monitor reliability and performance; troubleshoot deadlocks, blocking, long-running queries, resource utilization, and application/database issues.
·    Maintain data integrity, security, availability, backup/recovery practices, and compliance controls.
·    Develop, debug, refactor, review, deploy, and support ASP.NET/.NET applications, React Native, and IIS-hosted services.
AI, Cloud & Integration

·    
Prototype and deploy AI capabilities that use AlarisPro’s trusted operational data to improve maintenance, safety, compliance, and fleet decisions.
·    Build and consume secure REST APIs using appropriate authentication patterns, including JWT, OAuth 2.0, API keys, and related controls.
·    Contribute to cloud architecture, deployment automation, observability, CI/CD, testing, and scalable service design, with an emphasis on AWS environments.
·    Help evaluate new models, frameworks, and coding agents; document findings, technical decisions, and measurable product outcomes.
Product, Design & Collaboration

·   
 Partner with customers and stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, risks, and decisions—not simply requested features.
·    Use Design Thinking and product management methods to frame problems, prototype quickly, test assumptions, prioritize value, and iterate from evidence.
·    Bridge aviation operational requirements, product objectives, user experience, and technical constraints to develop effective, practical software solutions.
·    Contribute to roadmaps, requirements, acceptance criteria, code reviews, technical documentation, testing, and release readiness.

What We Are Looking For:

Required Experience

·   
 Hands-on development with C# or VB.NET and ASP.NET Web Forms, MVC, .NET Core, or a comparable .NET application environment.
·    Experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with cloud-hosted applications, databases, or services.
·    Front-end development experience; HTML, JavaScript, CSS, React or comparable modern frameworks are strongly valued.
·    Practical experience using Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI coding tools.
·    Working knowledge of Git, testing, secure development, code review, deployment, and production troubleshooting.
·    Ability to contribute across the stack, communicate clearly, ask good questions, reliably estimate tasks assigned, document work, and deliver reliably and on time in a fast-moving environment.
Preferred Experience
·    3+ years of professional software or data-platform engineering experience, including meaningful hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL.
·    AWS architecture, application/API hosting, WebSocket’s, managed databases, and cloud observability.
·    SQL Agent automation, Microsoft SQL database administration, IIS configuration, high availability, and performance engineering.
·    Applied AI/ML, LLM integrations, retrieval-augmented generation, automated integration testing, model evaluation, or MLOps/LLMOps.
·    Product discovery, Design Thinking, user research, prototyping, backlog prioritization, or product management practices.
·    Experience in aviation, UAS/drone operations, fleet operations of any type, preventive maintenance, safety, regulatory compliance, or other high-reliability domains are a plus.

Our Approach to AI-Assisted Development

We value speed, curiosity, and strong tool fluency. We also expect engineering judgment. AI-generated code must be understood, reviewed, tested, secured, documented, and operated like any other production code. The goal is not to generate more code; it is to deliver better outcomes faster.

Success in This Role

Success in this role means consistently delivering high-quality software solutions that improve the AlarisPro platform and provide meaningful value to our customers. The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
·       Ownership and Accountability:
Take responsibility for assigned projects and deliver reliable, well-tested solutions on schedule with minimal oversight.
·        Productivity and Execution:
Consistently make measurable progress, manage priorities effectively, and deliver results in a fast-paced development environment.
·        Problem-Solving:
Independently analyze complex challenges, identify practical solutions, and exercise sound technical judgment.
·        User-Centered Design:
Apply Design Thinking principles to translate aviation operational requirements and customer needs into intuitive, efficient software solutions.
·        Software Quality:
Develop maintainable, scalable, and secure code while minimizing defects, technical debt, and unnecessary complexity.
·        Collaboration and Communication:
Work effectively with leadership, product stakeholders, and fellow engineers while proactively communicating progress, challenges, and solutions.
·        Continuous Improvement:
Demonstrate initiative in improving existing functionality, development processes, and overall user experience.
·        Business and Mission Awareness:
Understand how software development decisions affect customer operations, aviation safety, regulatory compliance, and AlarisPro's business objectives.

Why Join AlarisPro?

Join AlarisPro at an exciting stage of growth and innovation, where you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the future of unmanned systems. You'll help shape the continued evolution of a proven, industry-leading platform at the intersection of aviation safety, cloud technology, and applied AI. Leveraging extensive real-world operational data, you'll contribute to the development of next-generation capabilities in predictive maintenance, reliability analytics, and intelligent decision support that improve aviation safety and operational efficiency.
